summary.text:
Global equities dropped, with the Nikkei 225 losing 4.49% and the S&P 500 down 2.02%, as the VIX surged 15.8% to 28.44. A tech sell-off followed Anthropic's debut, dragging SoftBank down over 16%. Meanwhile, the US approved over 879,000 AI chip sales to Chinese firms, and SpaceX lenders moved to bar a $40 billion chip launch.

The US Dollar Index was unchanged at 103.868. EUR/USD traded at 1.0976, USD/JPY slipped 0.14% to 159.163, and GBP/USD fell 0.38% to 1.3097. Gold stood at 3530.6001, while WTI and Brent crude remained flat at 82.78 and 89.87, respectively. Bitcoin shed 1.54% to 62019.6602.

Going forward, monitor ongoing volatility tied to Anthropic's debut, rising Japanese core inflation following expired energy subsidies, and the US Department of Justice closing its antitrust inquiry into NextEra's acquisition of Dominion.
